He also submits that respondent No. 3 by his order No. 37 and Memo No. Judge/ Band/2013-144 dated 27-5-2013 asked the petitioners to appear before him on 30-5-2013 with their admit Cards, Original Copies of the certificates of academic qualifications, Nationality Certificate and other relevant papers for appointment and the petitioners appeared before him, produced and deposited the Certificates and the respondent No. 3 took their interview and found the petitioners perfectly qualified and delaying their appointment by issuing appointment letters is illegal and malafide. 

 20. Learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner in course of submissions referred the case of Md Sirajul Islam vs Bangladesh reported in 27 BLD (HCD) 355 (2007) = 60 DLR 79, 15 MLR (AD) 425 (2010), 22 BLD (AD) 199 (2002) = 7 BLC (AD) 144, 22 BLD 387, 23 BLD 7 (2003) = 8 BLC 1, 52 DLR 7, 52 DLR 308. The rule is being contested by Respondent No. 1 by filing affidavit-in-opposition. 

 23. Heard the learned Advocate for the petitioners as well as the learned Assistant Attorney-General appearing for the respondent No. 1, considered the statement as made in the application under Article 102 of the Constitution of the People's Republic of Bangladesh and also considered the affidavit-in-opposition filed by respondent No. 1 against the writ petition also considered the submissions as well as the citations as referred by the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner in support of his contention. On perusal of the impugned Memo No. CJM/Ba-Ban/2011-137 dated 1-11-2011 and Memo No. CJM/Ba-Ban/ 2011-162 dated 27-12-2011 and the Memo No. CJM/BaBan/2013-7(Ka) dated 6-1-2013 issued by Chairman/11, Selection Committee and Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bandarban to the appointing authority, the District Judge, Bandarban Parbattya Zilla, Bandarban vide Annexure-C, C-1 and E to the writ petition and also Order No. 37 dated 27-5-2013 issued under Memo No. Judge Band/2013-144 dated 27-5-2013 issued by learned District Judge and Sessions Judge, Bandarban Parbattya Zila, Vide Annexure-F to the writ petition.
